## Arxis Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Webcast


16 Jul, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.arxis.com/node/6931/pdf)


BLOOMFIELD, Conn.


, July 16, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Arxis, Inc. (NASDAQ: ARXS) today announced that it will release its financial results for the second quarter of 2026 after the market closes on Wednesday, July 29, 2026.


Arxis will host a conference call and webcast to discuss its financial results on Thursday, July 30, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET. The webcast will be available to the public in listen-only mode.


The webcast link and accompanying slide presentation can be accessed through the Events section of the Company's website at[https://ir.arxis.com/news-events/events](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4733199-1&h=3409618189&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.arxis.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents&a=https%3A%2F%2Fir.arxis.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents) . A replay of the webcast will be available on the Company's website following the call.


**About Arxis**


Arxis is a leading designer and manufacturer of proprietary, mission-critical electronic and mechanical components for aerospace and defense, medical technology, and specialized industrial markets. Leveraging significant intellectual property and world-class engineering and operational capabilities, Arxis designs and delivers innovative solutions that address its customers' most complex performance needs. Arxis is a portfolio company of Arcline Investment Management. For more information, visit[www.arxis.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4733199-1&h=462770137&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4701684-1%26h%3D214786505%26u%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Fwww.arxis.com%252F%26a%3Dwww.arxis.com&a=www.arxis.com) .
